name: BeCubed Summer 2018

venue.name: Anderson-Abruzzo Albuquerque International Balloon Museum
venue.address: 9201 Balloon Museum Dr. NE Albuquerque, New Mexico 87113

information: The registration fee for competitors is $30. Spectators will also have to pay in order to get in to the museum. Adults $4.00 ($1 discount with valid NM ID) Seniors 65+ $2.00 Children 4-12 $2.00 Children 3 and under Free Due to the size of the venue, there is a 100 competitor limit at this event and you must register online. NO refunds and NO day of registration.
